name: thrift
description: Spend less on tokens and money: a model router, a context coach, a context forecast and an instruction diet

routerMode.title: Model router
routerMode.description: off: no classification. suggest: a toast and a band line say which model fits the prompt. auto: the turn runs on that model.

trivialModel.title: Model for trivial prompts
trivialModel.description: Alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.

coachThreshold.title: Context coach threshold (tokens)
coachThreshold.description: The band offers a handoff or a compaction once the context passes this many tokens. 0 turns the coach off.

handoffPrompt.title: Handoff prompt
handoffPrompt.description: What the Hand off button sends.
handoffPrompt.default: Write a handoff note for the next session in docs/HANDOFF.md: the goal, the current state, what is done and how you know, what was tried and failed, the next step and how to verify it. Then say the path.

weather.title: Context forecast
weather.description: A band line with the context size, its growth per turn and the turns left before compaction.

diet.title: Instruction diet
diet.description: Adds /diet, a pane that drops system prompt sections for this project.
